resources.string:
## ✨ New

- **Explore extension search** — use the search button in Explore to find extensions from the list currently being shown without triggering a new network request or extension reload.
- **Editable global search query** — tap the query on the global search results screen, edit it, and run another search directly.
- **Selectable manga description** — Manga Details descriptions now support long-press text selection and Copy.
- **Prefilled manga edit form** — Name, Author, and Description are prefilled from the current manga details while existing overrides remain preferred.
- **Explore Suggestions visibility control** — an eye button beside Suggestions can show or hide the carousel and remembers the choice.

## 🔧 Improved

- **More compact Explore Suggestions** — cover size is reduced from 150×200 dp to 112×150 dp and carousel height from 232 dp to 184 dp.
- **Pin navigation UI** — pinned bottom navigation now stays fully visible while scrolling; disabling the option keeps the previous hide-on-scroll behavior.

## 🐞 Fixed

- **Large Favourites dialog crash** — FavoriteDialog now reads category membership only for the selected manga instead of scanning all active memberships on that path.
